headline: All in the next 50 days
dek: The President posts a list, attributed to Senator John Kennedy, of nominations and bills to pass in the next 50 days. Switzerland has reviewed the request.

original.speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: “I’m going to fight and get all of the President’s Nominees confirmed. Get the Permitting Bill passed. I want to do a Reconciliation Bill, which we can pass with no Democrat votes, provide money for the Military, money for Air Control, a Bill to ban Stock Trading, pass a Bill on Pardon Brokers, pass a Fraud Bill, all in the next 50 days. The FAA Funding should be a stand alone Bill — We should get Democrat support for that!”
original.key: pass a Fraud Bill, all in the next 50 days.
original.context: Posted on 14 November 2026. The President posts, in quotation marks, words he attributes to Senator John Kennedy of Louisiana.

verification.note: Copied by the editor from truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump on 14 November 2026 (shown as 11/14/26, 9:39 AM Pacific).

en: Switzerland admires the ambition: five bills and every nominee in 50 days.
Here, once Parliament passes a law, citizens get 100 days just to decide whether they want to vote on it.
Five bills in 50 days? We would still be in the consultation phase.
